profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at AAM - American Axle & Manufacturing
profile.summary:
Sr. Software Engineer developing Software for Electric Drive Unit for American Axle and Manufacturing.

Technical Skills:
Programming & Scripting Languages:  C, C++, Embedded C, Assembly(x86, ARM), JAVA,                          PYTHON, Matlab, Data Structures
Hardware: Infineum Tricore Microcontroller,  Tiva C Series Microcontroller (ARM M4F core),8085                microprocessor, 8051, NXP (LPC-2129), ENC28J60 Microchip Ethernet Controller, Arduino UNO REV 3
Programming Tools & Software :	Eclipse, EB-Tresos, Microsoft Visual Studio, Microsoft Visio, keil  µVision4, MATLAB,
Xilinx, TI-Code Composer Studio, Python IDE, NI Multisim, Proteus, Simulink, Wireshark, VI- editor
Protocols:	RS-232, RS-485, SPI, CAN, I2C, Bluetooth, DMX-512, TCP, UDP, Ethernet
Wireless Technologies:	GSM, LTE, OFDMA, CDMA2000, WCDMA, LAN/WAN, MIMO
Operating System:	Windows, Linux (Ubuntu), RTOS, Mac
Version Control Tool:	Git, Tortoise SVN
Linux Concepts:	Basic Shell Programming, Loadable Kernel Modules programming, GDB Debugger      
Multithreading:	POSIX thread programming


Experience working with Lab equipment such as Logical Analyser, CRO, Function Generator, Oscilloscopes, Breadboards.

Good understanding in concepts of Real Time Operating Systems.

Vector tools such as Canalyzer, Canoe

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design and develop embedded software for an Electronic Power Train application using C      language on Wind River IDE and run on the Infineon Tricore Aurix family of Microcontroller.
•	Implementing API modules as part of a BSP, which is based on an AUTOSAR design methodology.
•	BSP includes such modules as Peripheral Test, Memory Test, Stack Limit Test, Clock Status, Security Peripheral Support, Watchdog Timer, etc
•	Configure Infineon MCAL (Microcontroller Abstraction Layer) and integrate into BSP.
•	Providing UML diagrams for software development process
•	Follow an AGILE development process

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Arlington

projects.title: Implementing TCP/IP and UDP for IoT Application on ARM cortex M4
projects.description: Implemented a firmware for UDP which supports Ping Request and Response, ARP Request using Ethernet ENC28J60 chip and also Implementing TCP/IP stack to show IoT application.

projects.title: RS-485 based Asynchronous Communication Interface with DMX512-A Protocol:
projects.description: To build a device capable of acting as either a controller or device for asynchronous communications interface using DMX512-A protocol with EF1 topology where PC transmitter will accept commands from via an RS-232 interface and will continuously transmit a serial stream to control up to 512 devices on a RS-485 communication bus.
